Scheme

What is a scheme

Default colors, sizes, fonts, shapes,... of an application and much more are specified in its scheme. The XML description currently allows you to override colors, sizes, cursors and fonts in a <scheme> section.

HOWTO describe colors


<scheme>
    <!-- place colors, sizes,.. here -->
</scheme>
